description: Coverage pre-check for whether Signal8 holds a dilution analysis for a company (a lighter read than the full dilution payloads): coverage status (verified / stale / not_covered), extraction state (never_extracted / running / failed / timeout / complete), last attempt and last success timestamps, the coverage tier, and whether the ticker is out of scope. `outOfScope` is a statement about the product (dilution analysis covers small-cap issuers only) and says nothing about that company's dilution. `stale` means the analysis is real but predates recent filings; `statusDetail` refines it: `newer_filing_unread` (`unreadFilings` names the material filings since: new or amended instrument, 424B5 pricing, split, 10-K) or `delisting_filed` (`delistingFiled` names the Form 25/25-NSE/15). A stale analysis describes the company as it stood before that filing, not as of today. A null `unreadFilings` means not measured, not "nothing filed since". Returns HTTP 200 for unavailable data; the `available` and `reason` fields say why. `not_covered` means this company has not been analysed yet, not that it has no dilution; an outage is a 5xx. A null, absent or withheld value means the figure was not measured; it does not mean "no dilution", "no warrants", "no shelf" or zero. A numeric 0 is a measured zero, so availability is carried by the availability, withheld and reason fields, not by the value. Included in Signal8 Pro: without it the call returns 403 FEATURE_NOT_AVAILABLE with `requiredTier: "pro"` (a tier upgrade; there is no add-on to buy).
name: get_dilution_coverage
title: Get Dilution Coverage Status
